vendor_modifications: PRW LogitsWarper import falls back to LogitsProcessor when the former API is absent. Algorithm and score formulas unchanged.
adapter_changes: SIR checkpoint/mapping resolved from explicit persisted assets rather than mutable working-directory defaults.
Embedding and transformation networks put in eval mode for deterministic inference; pinned embedding revision. Upstream wrapper did not explicitly set eval mode.
SIR native no-evidence NaN represented by null and availability flag; zero-imputed only at classifier input export.
Added section-level features, order labels, grouped splits and OLS/SVM/MLP evaluation; these are research extensions, not claims of paper order-attribution code.
